resources.string: Keep text only

Audio is held temporarily for transcription, without playback or download. It is cleaned up after successful transcription. Start or retry transcription within 30 minutes after ending; audio expires within 24 hours after starting. Unuploaded audio stays in memory and cannot be recovered if the recording service ends. Start transcription separately; it uses AI quota.
Text-only recording is currently unavailable. Choose audio retention or try again later.
Recording ended
Recording was interrupted. Temporary audio may be missing. Resume before expiry, or explicitly end with the audio already received by the server.
Only text is retained. Uploaded audio follows the server retention window; unuploaded audio is temporary and cannot be recovered after the recording process ends.
Temporary audio has expired. Recording has stopped; end the recording to finish processing its available text.
Stop recording and finish uploading available audio. Then check transcription and temporary-audio cleanup status.
End with incomplete audio
End this recording using only audio already received by the server. Remaining local audio will be discarded and missing parts cannot be recovered. The result will be marked incomplete.
Discard missing audio and end
